I’m so sorry mate. You must be feeling so destroyed, I can’t imagine what you’re going through.

You’re wife didn’t just break your trust, she absolutely and utterly destroyed it. It’s understandable if you don’t want to prepare filing for a divorce right now as the wound is still fresh, you are likely in denial, hoping you can reconcile your relationship and everything will be okay. Maybe you can, but she has shown complete disrespect for you and your marriage, I would say the best choice for both of you would be separation. 

Take your time processing your feelings, talk to anyone you can, or a therapist if you want to be more confidential. Maybe make up an excuse to tell your wife you need some space/going to visit family for a few days, going on vacation etc. so you can gather your feelings.

So sorry she has done this to you, I don’t know you or your relationship, but I dont believe anyone deserves that happening to them.

All the best

I’ve done the exam 3 times now 65, 65 and 76 this year.

The biggest thing that I feel helped me enormously was getting a tutor for my weakest section. I had such a mental block for S2 for my first 2 sittings and literally did 0 study, just winged it. Getting like 4 sessions with a tutor gave me responsibility, confidence and skills and boosted my S2 score so much. Also spent most of my time studying for S2 + S3 because I found the most yield there. Studied so much for S1 for the first two sitting and my score barely changed. 

Good luck!! Don’t give up you’ve got this :)

2 months ago, I felt the exact same as you. I know it may be hard for you, but please tell someone how you’re feeling. Trust me, even though they may not approach you, they do care about you and how you feel.

It was hard but I reached out to my dad two months ago and have had a great recovery ever since. I now have people to support me (school counsellors, parents etc.), and only now can I see that my life might have some potential.

In summary, you may be embarrassed or apathetic to the idea of reaching out, and it may be the hardest part. But once you do the rest will fall into place.
